description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Modal' that renders a Material-UI modal dialog. It includes styling with Material-UI's makeStyles, manages modal positioning state, and exposes an API via props for controlling its open state and handling close events.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: A hook created by makeStyles to generate styling classes for the modal component, specifically the 'paper' style.

methods.name: getModalStyle
methods.description: Function computing the inline style object for centering the modal on the screen.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a Material-UI modal with configurable opening and closing behavior, and customizable children content.
